findings.title: Selected revision helper code executes during measurement
findings.narrow_fix: Use independently pinned, trusted helper source (verified by immutable revision/hash) or implement the required helper logic in the counter; do not import source from the revision being measured.

findings.title: List-nested refusal envelope is counted

reproduction.observed: t1_exercised_count=1 and identify-flutter-build exercised=true although data.raw_result contains a list item with ok=false and error.code=capability_unavailable

findings.narrow_fix: Recursively traverse dicts and lists beneath raw_result/normalized_result and apply refusal checks to each object; add a list-nested refusal control.

findings.title: Lossy UTF-8 replacement lets malformed evidence bind
findings.narrow_fix: Read retained evidence blobs as bytes and strict-decode UTF-8 before parsing; keep any replacement decoding needed for prose separate from evidence JSON.
